about_the_game:
STORY

March 5, 20XX

Hikaru, a seemingly cynical and grumpy young man, who ran away from home for unknown reasons, has earned himself a really bad reputation over the last two years. But even though he's dissatisfied with his current living conditions, he can't find the right motivation to make a significant change and get back on track.

Aiko, on the other hand, is his complete opposite: lively and naive, she unwillingly wreaks havoc with her behaviour wherever she goes, and she always manages to overcome the hardships she bumps into. There's only one thing on her mind: achieving her goal, for which she is willing to give it her all.

Their paths, by pure chance, cross: to pursue their goals, they make a deal.

Choose your protagonist!

Take on Aiko’s mantle and face countless opponents in a mysterious fighting Tournament, where your abilities and your judgement will be put to the test, or help Hikaru unveil all the mysteries and secrets that hide behind this Tournament and its participants.

Whatever you choose… try to stay alive.

CHARACTERS

Hikaru Laine

A seemingly grumpy and cynical guy.
For some personal reasons, Hikaru left his home and, over the last two years, lived in the streets as a thief. He’s pretty fast and also skilled in the petty theft. He runs into Aiko during one of these robberies and, due to his curiosity, he decides to follow the girl to learn more about her.

Aiko Eichel 

She participates in the Tournament and, according to rumours, is one of the strongest challengers. Determination is one of her main characteristics: she would do anything to achieve her goal. She’s clumsy and always tries to do her best when it comes to approaching other people. Her being so naive often leads her into trouble. 

Kyoko Graedir

Kyoko’s at the head of the Tournament’s staff.
Her job is to keep an eye on the work of her collaborators. She’s also a doctor.
Aiko often calls her “mom”, implying that there’s a particular relationship between the two.
She’s very wise and insightful, but at the same time easily irritable.

Minato Stehali

Aiko’s self-proclaimed big brother. He gets easily jealous when it comes to the girl and can't stand anyone who approaches her. Minato has an overwhelming personality: his manner of speech is so strange that it’s hard to know when he’s serious or when he’s joking. He also participates in the tournament and is always in the company of Ringo, his dog.

Reko R. Vom Brand

A mysterious Tournament challenger.
Whispers say to be one of the most ruthless challengers and has never lost a fight.
Nothing else is known.

Nevy

He’s a Tournament challenger, too. No other information is available at the moment.

FEATURES

  • A Character-Driven Story

Although you can’t choose who you romance, the characters and the relationships that will form between them lie at the heart of the story.

  • 2 Points of View

Aiko and Hikaru are the two protagonists of the story. Depending on the character you choose to play as, some events in the story and CGs will change.

  • Multiple Choices

20+ Possible Endings

Around 40 hours of gameplay

  • 19 Original Soundtracks

  • 26+ Backgrounds

  • 30+ CGs to unlock

  • A lot of chibi CGs

short_description: An Adventure Visual Novel where you can choose your protagonist – Play as Aiko or Hikaru as they try to uncover the secrets that lurk all around them in this character-driven story. Every choice you make will have an impact on the story.
